task.title: Generate the authority and downstream packs
task.shortdesc: Pick an AI system and builds two evidence packs from its DITA source, then measures them.

context.p: Start on . The page runs the four checks and builds both packs in one step. You don't need an account, and nothing you do changes the source.

step.cmd: Under Pick a system, choose a system.

info.p: Only a system with an evidence set can be chosen. Today that is Gemma 4. A system without one is listed but can't be selected.
The first run after a quiet period can take about 15 seconds while the service starts. Later runs take about a second.

The Authority pack is for the AI Office (Annex XI, Section 1). The Downstream pack is for providers who build on the model (Annex XII). Each card shows a status, the four check tiles (coverage, currency, approval, consistency), the requirements that have no evidence, and its findings.

step.cmd: Select Download on a card to get that pack as a zip.

info.p: The card shows the manifest hash before you download. The download carries the same hash.

step.cmd: Read the Metrics from the design table under the packs.

info.p: Each row says whether the number was measured on this run, modeled in the design only, or is not part of the MVP. See .

result.p: You have two zips. Each holds the DITA-OT HTML5 and PDF output built with that reader's profile, a manifest, a report, a coverage table and SHA-256 hashes. These are demonstration packs: they are hashed, but never released or sealed.
